svg.title: Biscuit wardriving hardware and data roles
svg.desc: Compares single-C5 Crumb and DIY devices, Pro and Ultra multi-MCU devices, and optional satellite Nodes. A phone provides app control and location for phone-managed sessions; only Pro or Ultra can manage Nodes. One C5 scans across Wi-Fi bands over time, while BLE phone control can reduce observation time.
svg.text: Biscuit hardware roles, control, and location
Use the exact model and firmware documentation; session and storage behavior vary by device.
Biscuit Manager phone
Bluetooth control • app session/export
Phone GPS locates phone-managed sessions
app link
app link
Crumb / DIY • one ESP32-C5
• One Wi-Fi radio scans supported channels over time
2.4 GHz and 5 GHz are not simultaneous captures
• BLE phone control can reduce Wi-Fi observation time
• Phone session/export is the usual record path
SD logging depends on the exact supported board/build
Pro / Ultra • multi-MCU platform
• Pro: C5 scanner + WROOM controller; Ultra: two-chip platform
Check each SKU's model documentation for exact MCU roles
• Phone manages sessions and supplies their location
• Eligible Pro/Ultra Manager can enroll supported Nodes
SD and other features vary by exact SKU/firmware
Manager connection
Optional satellite Biscuit Node • separate firmware
Assigned Wi-Fi or BLE role; no direct phone pairing or GPS
Observations report to the Manager; location comes from its phone
Basic phone-managed survey needs no Node. Keep the phone beside the scanner;
a remote scanner inherits phone location and can produce misleading coordinates.
